punjabi dhaba::butter chicken.description: Rich, creamy tomato gravy with succulent grilled chicken bites.
steps: Marinate chicken in yogurt and spices for 2 hours.
Grill or sear chicken in butter until charred.
Prepare tomato gravy with butter, cream, and garam masala.
Simmer chicken in gravy for 15 minutes and serve hot with Naan.

royal spice::paneer butter masala.description: Soft cottage cheese cubes in a mildly sweet, buttery tomato gravy.
steps: Sauté tomato and cashew paste in butter until oil separates.
Add cream, spices, and kasuri methi to make a smooth gravy.
Add fresh paneer cubes and simmer gently for 5 minutes.

pizzeria roma::margherita pizza.description: Classic Neapolitan pizza with fresh mozzarella, basil, and San Marzano tomato sauce.
steps: Spread tomato sauce evenly leaving crust borders.
Top with torn fresh mozzarella and basil leaves.
Bake in wood-fired oven at 450°C for 90 seconds until crust is charred.
